headerDisplay: Homebridge Electromagnetic Lock plugin to control electromagnetic lock via Raspberry Pi GPIO lines connected to relay.

lockPin.title: Lock GPIO line
lockPin.description: BCM GPIO / libgpiod line number for unlocking lock, not physical board pin

gpioChip.title: GPIO chip
gpioChip.description: GPIO chip number used by libgpiod, usually 0 on Raspberry Pi

activeLow.title: Relay activated by low state?
activeLow.description: true: relay activated by low state (0), false: relay activated by high state (1), affects lockPin

unlockingDuration.title: Unlocking duration (seconds)
unlockingDuration.description: how long lockPin should be active (seconds), default: 2
